claims.text: One or a few superficial lesions: intralesional vinblastine or interferon alfa
claims.quote: One or a few superficial lesions can be removed by excision, cryotherapy, or electrocoagulation or treated with intralesional vinblastine or interferon alfa.

claims.text: Advanced HIV with limited skin disease: intralesional vinblastine or bleomycin can be added; pomalidomide for more indolent lesions
claims.quote: In patients with advanced HIV who have limited cutaneous disease, intralesional vinblastine or bleomycin can be added (3). Pomalidomide can also be used for more indolent lesions.

claims.text: Extensive or visceral disease: pegylated liposomal doxorubicin 20 mg/m2 IV every 2 to 3 weeks; paclitaxel is an alternative first-line choice or used if it fails
claims.quote: Patients with more extensive or visceral disease can be given pegylated liposomal doxorubicin 20 mg/m2 IV every 2 to 3 weeks (3). Paclitaxel is an alternative first-line treatment or can be given if pegylated liposomal doxorubicin fails.
